violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. -Repair edge of front line flat top as there is exposed rubber that is not cleanable.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. -Clean lobby soda dispenser. -Clean soft serve machines.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Clean shelving and fronts and sides of all cook line equipment.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. -Floor tiles have cracks in dishwash area. -Floors in walk in freezer are rusty.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Floors walls and ceiling need further cleaning.
General premises. — --Perimeter walls and roof did not effectively protect establishment from the weather and entry of insects, rodents, and other animals. -Back door has gap at bottom.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. -Clean outside ice machine.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Clean all shelving, carts and racks in kitchen and prep area.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Floors, walls and ceilings need deep cleaned. -Tile floors are in poor condition and need replaced.
